front_matter.title: Building blocks
front_matter.description: Every building block of Harbor, by layer, with the blocks it depends on.
front_matter.lede: 5 blocks in 3 layers. Each block is a contract of commands, events and views.

markdown:
The blocks declare 4 entities, 8 commands and 8 events. An arrow points from a block to a block it depends on; point at a block to see what it uses and what uses it.

<LayerMap data={page.data["map"]} presentation={site.presentation} />

## Every block

| layer | block | what it is | depends on | KPIs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **2** craft | [tug](./2-craft/tug.mdx) | Tows a vessel between the open water and its berth. | [vessel](./2-craft/vessel.mdx) | 1 |
|  | [vessel](./2-craft/vessel.mdx) | A craft that comes in, moors at a berth and leaves. | [berth](./1-shore/berth.mdx) | 1 |
| **1** shore | [berth](./1-shore/berth.mdx) | A place at a quay where one vessel moors. | [quay](./1-shore/quay.mdx) | 1 |
|  | [quay](./1-shore/quay.mdx) | A stretch of shore where berths are laid out. | – | 0 |
| **0** bedrock | [ledger](./0-bedrock/ledger.mdx) | Identifiers of every entity of the harbor blocks. | – | 0 |

## Planned blocks

The KPI catalogue already measures blocks the blocks do not declare yet: [crane](./planned.mdx#crane). See [planned blocks](./planned.mdx).
